global_caption: The video contains 6 shots. It is a low-saturation pixel art style cooking tutorial set in a space station. The overall visual tone uses cool gray hues with slight cyan-blue tint, appearing subdued, retro, and featuring clear pixel grain. There is no Lighting primarily features natural cold light from the viewport and faint functional glow from kitchen equipment indicators. The emotional tone remains consistently quiet and focused.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, wide shot at eye level to establish the environment. Composition places the viewport slightly right in the background, foreground shows floating but magnetically secured ingredients and utensils, midground features an elderly woman standing at the zero-gravity kitchen counter. The cutting board is firmly attached to the surface, with carrots, bell peppers, seasoning jars, and the magnetic pot arranged in order. Shallow depth of field still preserves spatial layering. Stars slowly drifting outside the viewport reinforce the space station setting. Cold light softly illuminates the edges of the kitchen. The first phrase of electronic piano The camera slowly pushes in and slightly pans, clearly establishing the teaching starting point and all tool positions.
shot2: Shot 2 follows with a hard cut from the previous shot, close-up at slightly overhead-to-eye-level angle focusing on the cutting board and hands. The elderly woman chops carrots first, then bell peppers in sequence, producing uniformly sized pieces. Ingredients briefly float upward when the knife lifts, then are gently pulled back by the magnetic edge of the board. Pixelated cross-sections display clean, distinct colors. Under cool lighting, the metallic blade reflects fine highlights. The electronic piano phrase becomes sharper and more rhythmic, aligning precisely with the knife's downward strokes. The camera performs a small lateral follow movement, emphasizing procedural precision and clarity of hand movements.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions via hard cut to an extreme close-up at eye level with slight upward tilt, focusing on the magnetic pot’s opening and ingredient trajectory. Foreground shows a small container being held up, background blurred to viewport edge and control panel. The elderly woman slowly pours the chopped vegetables into the pot. In zero gravity, carrots and bell peppers initially scatter lightly before being drawn into the pot by the magnetic field and airflow at the pot’s rim. Material texture shifts from dry, crisp chunks to slightly glossy upon contact with the hot surface. Pixelated highlights around the pot edge echo the device indicator lights. The magnetic stove’s mechanical startup After a brief pause, the electronic piano delivers an ascending note. The camera subtly tilts down following the falling ingredients, ensuring the entire pouring process is clearly visible.
shot4: Shot 4 connects via hard cut to a medium close-up at eye level, capturing the stir-frying action. Composition places the upper body of the person on the left, leaving the right side for the cookware and rising pixelated steam. Background retains the viewport and kitchen wall, maintaining scene continuity. The elderly woman holds the pot handle with one hand and rapidly stirs with a spatula in the other. Vegetables inside the pot become more vivid in color under heat but maintain low-saturation pixel texture. Steam rises as block-shaped particles and gradually fades in the cold light. The sleeve edge and strands of white hair sway gently with ventilation. The camera performs a small arc pan and slight push-in, enhancing action continuity and sense of increasing heat.
shot5: Shot 5 transitions via hard cut to an overhead extreme close-up. The center of the frame is the food in the pot, with seasoning bottle and spoon appearing in the foreground above. Faint glowing patterns of the stove surface are visible in the background. The elderly woman adds seasonings sequentially. Liquids and powders quickly coat the vegetable surfaces. The pot’s state shifts from dry to thin, shiny sauce. The pixelated reduction process is shown as surface highlights gradually concentrate and steam becomes finer. Cool light remains dominant, with only localized warm glows from the stove surface. The camera gently lowers and stabilizes, ensuring seasoning order and final transformation are clearly visible.
shot6: Shot 6 connects via a soft fade-in/fade-out to a pull-back to medium-wide shot at eye level with slight downward tilt, concluding the sequence. Composition creates front-to-back layering between the workbench and viewport. The finished dish is placed in a shallow plate and floats steadily in microgravity to a fixed tray near the window. The elderly woman gently adjusts the plate’s edge, completing the full tutorial loop from chopping, cooking, stir-frying, to plating. Pixelated steam gradually dissipates. The star-filled sky outside becomes a tranquil backdrop. The cool gray tone remains consistent. The electronic piano delivers its final gentle closing phrase. The camera slowly pulls back and gently tilts upward, keeping the finished dish, character, and space station viewport within the frame, clearly ending the instructional flow.
